gaps.lead: The athlete denied taking performance-enhancing drugs.
gaps.explanation: deny + having + past participle (or deny taking).

gaps.lead: We expect to announce the winner tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: We expect to announce X → X is expected to be announced.

gaps.lead: When I was a boy, we walked everywhere.
gaps.sentence: When I was a boy, we ___ everywhere.
gaps.explanation: used to + infinitive expresses a past habit.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: I regret telling her the secret.
gaps.explanation: I regret -ing = I shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: The show was so dull that half the audience left.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that half the audience left.
gaps.explanation: so dull (a show) → such a dull show.
